children: HONDA MOTOR CO., LTD. - NISSAN AND HONDA CONCLUDE JOINT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT TO STANDARDIZE ECUS AND SOFTWARE FOR NEXT-GENERATION SDVS

HONDA MOTOR CO.- NISSAN MOTOR  AND HONDA ENTERED INTO A JOINT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT TO STANDARDIZE MULTIPLE ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNITS (ECUS) THAT FORM THE CORE OF NEXT-GENERATION SOFTWARE-DEFINED VEHICLES (SDVS)
HONDA MOTOR CO - JOINT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ALSO INCLUDE IN-VEHICLE OPERATING SYSTEM AND KEY PARTS OF THE MIDDLEWARE, AND VEHICLE CONTROL SOFTWARE THAT RUN ON THESE ECUS
HONDA MOTOR CO - THE E/E ARCHITECTURE INCORPORATING THE JOINTLY DEVELOPED ECUS AND SOFTWARE IS PLANNED FOR APPLICATION IN BOTH COMPANIES' NEXT-GENERATION SDVS FROM FISCAL YEAR 2029 ONWARD
